import os
import pandas as pd
import trino
conn = trino.dbapi.connect(host=os.environ["TRINO_HOST"], port=int(os.environ["TRINO_PORT"]),
    user=os.environ["TRINO_USER"], http_scheme="http", catalog="lakehouse")
def sql(statement):
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(statement)
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    columns = [c[0] for c in cur.description] if cur.description else []
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=columns)

sql("""
    CREATE TABLE lakehouse.gold.dim_user AS
    SELECT
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS user_key,
        user_id, username, name, sex, birthdate, city, state, zip_code
    FROM lakehouse.silver.users
""")

sql("""
    CREATE TABLE lakehouse.gold.dim_product AS
    SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY product) AS product_key, product
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product FROM lakehouse.silver.orders)
""")

first_day, last_day = sql("""
    SELECT CAST(min(ordered_at) AS date) AS first_day,
           CAST(max(ordered_at) AS date) AS last_day
    FROM lakehouse.silver.orders
""").iloc[0]
print(first_day, last_day)

sql(f"""
    CREATE TABLE lakehouse.gold.dim_date AS
    SELECT
        CAST(date_format(CAST(d AS timestamp), '%Y%m%d') AS integer) AS date_key,
        d                                       AS full_date,
        year(d)                                 AS year,
        quarter(d)                              AS quarter,
        month(d)                                AS month,
        date_format(CAST(d AS timestamp), '%M') AS month_name,
        day_of_week(d)                          AS day_of_week,
        day_of_week(d) IN (6, 7)                AS is_weekend
    FROM UNNEST(sequence(DATE '{first_day}', DATE '{last_day}', INTERVAL '1' DAY)) AS t(d)
""")

sql("""
    MERGE INTO lakehouse.gold.orders_by_state_month AS t
    USING (
        SELECT u.state, date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
               count(*) AS orders, sum(o.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS buyers
        FROM lakehouse.silver.orders o JOIN lakehouse.silver.users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) AS s
    ON t.state = s.state AND t.month = s.month
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET orders = s.orders, units = s.units, buyers = s.buyers
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (state, month, orders, units, buyers) VALUES (s.state, s.month, s.orders, s.units, s.buyers)
""")

import os, pandas as pd, trino
pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
conn = trino.dbapi.connect(host=os.environ["TRINO_HOST"], port=int(os.environ["TRINO_PORT"]), user=os.environ["TRINO_USER"], http_scheme="http", catalog="lakehouse")
def sql(statement):
    cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute(statement); rows = cur.fetchall()
    columns = [c[0] for c in cur.description] if cur.description else []
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=columns)

# Defaut 1 : un user_id present deux fois dans dim_user (simule, sans ecriture)
sql("""
    WITH dim_user_dup AS (
        SELECT user_key, user_id FROM lakehouse.gold.dim_user
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 999, user_id FROM lakehouse.gold.dim_user WHERE user_id = '9793b9b4-1374-4146-b2c5-bd89b70b3420'
    )
    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.orders) AS silver_orders,
           count(*) AS fact_orders_simule
    FROM lakehouse.silver.orders o LEFT JOIN dim_user_dup u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
""")

# Defaut 2 : une commande sans produit (NULL), simulee sans ecriture
sql("""
    WITH orders_null AS (
        SELECT order_id, product FROM lakehouse.silver.orders
        UNION ALL SELECT 'x-null-product', CAST(NULL AS varchar)
    )
    SELECT count(*) AS orders, count_if(p.product_key IS NULL) AS product_key_null
    FROM orders_null o LEFT JOIN lakehouse.gold.dim_product p ON p.product = o.product
""")

# Defaut 3 : ajout d'un utilisateur dans dim_user reconstruite avec row_number() (simule)
sql("""
    WITH new_dim AS (
        SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS user_key, user_id
        FROM (SELECT user_id FROM lakehouse.silver.users
              UNION ALL SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a')
    )
    SELECT o.user_id, o.user_key AS cle_actuelle, n.user_key AS cle_apres_reconstruction
    FROM lakehouse.gold.dim_user o JOIN new_dim n ON n.user_id = o.user_id
    WHERE o.user_key <> n.user_key ORDER BY o.user_key LIMIT 5
""")

sql("""
    WITH new_dim AS (
        SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS user_key, user_id
        FROM (SELECT user_id FROM lakehouse.silver.users
              UNION ALL SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a')
    )
    SELECT count_if(o.user_key <> n.user_key) AS users_dont_la_cle_change, count(*) AS users
    FROM lakehouse.gold.dim_user o JOIN new_dim n ON n.user_id = o.user_id
""")
